# `llm` operations

The exact fields each `llm.*` operation takes and returns.

<!-- Generated by `python scripts/codegen/docs_reference.py` from the op registry; edit the models, not this page. -->

Every op is `POST /v1/<op>` over HTTP and the MCP tool `loom_<op>`. The identity fields (`org`, `namespace`, `agent`, `user_id`, `session_id`) are filled from the token and the MCP session when a transport can; see [identities and namespaces](../../concepts/identities-and-namespaces.md). The [operations index](../operations.md) explains role, kind and the MCP `all` listing. Unknown input fields are served and named in `ignored_args`.

<!-- prettier-ignore-start -->

## `llm.complete`

`POST /v1/llm.complete` · MCP `loom_llm_complete` · role `viewer` · write · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `system` | `str` | required |  |
| `user` | `str` | required |  |
| `max_tokens` | `int` | `1024` |  |
| `response_format` | `dict[str, str] \| None` | `None` | OpenAI's `{"type": "json_object"}`; providers without it ignore the hint. |
| `temperature` | `float \| None` | `0.0` |  |
| `model` | `str` | `''` | The model the replica routed to (a stage override such as the rerank model); empty = the main Loom's default LLM. |
| `stage` | `str` | `''` | The replica's cascade leg (`llm_stage`), so the main Loom's generation reports under the stage that asked for it. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `str` |  |
| `tokens_in` | `int` |  |
| `tokens_out` | `int` |  |
| `provider` | `str` |  |
| `model` | `str` |  |
| `cached_input_tokens` | `int` |  |
| `cache_write_input_tokens` | `int` |  |
| `stop_reason` | `str` |  |
